data.gender_notes: Fidraah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The gentle breeze of dawn, signifying the beginning of a new day and the blessings of Allah. The name Fidraah carries the meaning “Morning breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fidraah usually hope their child will grow to embody morning breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the renewal and freshness of faith.
data.etymology: Fidraah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Morning breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fidraah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Fidraah" evokes a sense of serene tranquility in the Middle Eastern culture, as dawn often brings a fresh start and a chance for new beginnings. The term is derived from the Arabic word "Fidr," meaning gentle breeze, which signifies the start of a new day with its arrival.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the dawn is considered a sacred time, marked by the recitation of Fajr, one of the five daily prayers. The arrival of the "Fidraah" breeze thus symbolizes a spiritual renewal. It is a reminder to begin each day with devotion to Allah, seeking guidance, forgiveness, and strength. Furthermore, it is a reminder of the continuous cycle of life, where one day ends, and another begins, and ultimately, all things are subject to Allah's will. thus imparting a deep sense of reverence, unity, and faith to the one who bears the name "Fidraah."
